question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Perilous
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word '**Perilous**' means full of danger; hazardous; risky.(जोखिम, खतरनाक)

 
 
• **Example **- It was **perilous **to cross the river in a small boat during the storm.
 
 
 
• '**Dangerous**' means likely to cause injury or damage; full of risk or threat.(खतरनाक)
 
 
• **Example **- The chemicals in the lab are **dangerous **if not handled properly.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of** 'Perilous'** is **'Dangerous'**.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is **'****Dangerous'. **​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences.

 
• **Ugly **(भद्दा) - Unpleasant to look at or listen to; not attractive.

 
 
• **Example **- He thinks a lot of modern architecture is very **ugly**.
 
 
 
• **Adverse **(प्रतिकूल) - Making something difficult for somebody.
 
 
• **Example **- A divorce often has an **adverse **effect on the children.
 
 
 
• **Bad **(खराब, बुरा) - Of poor quality; of a low standard; not good; unpleasant.
 
 
• **Example **- The food at that restaurant was **bad**.
 
 

41:Tba2,

The correct answer is: **Option 1.**</p&
